description: The Vimshottari life chapter (mahadasha) and sub-chapter (antardasha) running today, with month and year, in plain language: what their planets stand for, the houses they sit in and guide, the life areas they touch, and when the next sub-chapter starts. Finer periods are not included. Up to 3 answers per chart every 6 hours, shared with chart_overview and life_area. Birth details are used only to calculate this answer; a one-way code is kept for 6 hours to apply fair-use limits.

birth_time.description: Local birth time as recorded, 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.
